headline: UK regulator issues operational AI governance guidance for pension schemes
summary: The UK Pensions Regulator published guidance on 29 October 2026 explaining how existing trustee and scheme-manager duties apply to AI used in pension schemes. It recommends risk-proportionate oversight, human accountability, provider assurance, continuity planning and attention to data, fairness and member support. TPR says the guidance creates no separate regulatory requirements; adoption and member outcomes are unmeasured.
